articles.title: Benefit Street Partners Provides $48M Refi for Brooklyn Mixed-Income Multifamily
articles.narrative: The Hudson Companies has secured a $47.6 million refinancing loan for The Clark, a 170-unit mixed-income multifamily property in Brooklyn. Benefit Street Partners provided the debt, which was arranged by Newmark. The refinancing is expected to provide stable footing for the asset, which was developed using the now-expired 421-a affordable housing abatement and includes market-rate, rent-stabilized, and affordable housing units.

data_points.notable_features: Mixed-income property with market-rate, rent-stabilized, and affordable housing units, plus ground-floor retail.
data_points.project_notes: Developed using the now-expired 421-a affordable housing abatement.

articles.title: Nuveen Acquires $445M Retail Portfolio Across Three Western States
articles.narrative: Nuveen Real Estate has acquired a 13-property retail portfolio across California, Colorado, and Washington for $445.5 million. The portfolio, totaling 1.89 million square feet, is 93.5% leased and primarily features grocery-anchored shopping centers. This transaction represents one of the largest grocery-anchored retail deals in the Western U.S. in recent years, reflecting strong investor demand for well-located retail assets with future growth potential amid limited new construction and robust residential populations.

data_points.notable_features: Portfolio includes six properties in California, four in Colorado, and three in Washington, primarily grocery-anchored shopping centers.

articles.financing: U.S. Bank provided $239 million in financing for 11 of the 13 properties, covering 54% of the total purchase price.
articles.market_intelligence: Investor demand for high-quality, well-located retail remains strong, particularly for grocery-anchored and open-air retail properties due to limited new construction and significant residential populations in the Western U.S.

articles.title: Retail, Residential Landlord Hubb NYC Signs 12K-SF Deal at 1501 Broadway
articles.narrative: Hubb NYC, a residential and retail property owner, has signed an 11,578-square-foot office lease at the Paramount Building in Midtown, relocating from its previous address at 579 Fifth Avenue. The move to 1501 Broadway underscores the building's appeal to a variety of office tenants, attributed to its prime Times Square location, significant ownership investment, high-quality finishes, and expanding amenity offerings.

data_points.notable_features: Located in Times Square, features Class A prebuilt finishes and a growing amenity package.

articles.market_intelligence: Average office asking rent in Midtown was $85.53 per square foot in Q3 2026.

articles.title: Terra, Fortune International Land $220M for Waterfront Condo near Miami
articles.narrative: Terra and Fortune International Group have secured a $220 million predevelopment loan for a 56-unit luxury condominium project on Key Biscayne, near Miami. The 13-story development, located at 301 Ocean Drive, will replace the former Silver Sands Beach Resort. The developers acquired the 3.8-acre waterfront site last year for $205 million and have obtained approvals for the project, which will include a subterranean parking garage. Sales for the new condo building are expected to commence later this year.

data_points.notable_features: Waterfront luxury condo development facing Biscayne Bay; includes a subterranean parking garage with 221 spots.
data_points.project_notes: The 3.8-acre property was previously acquired for $205 million in 2025. The development will replace the 56-room Silver Sands Beach Resort, built in 1956.

articles.title: PCCP Refis Long Island Apartments With $154M Loan
articles.narrative: Rechler Equity Partners secured a $154.25 million loan from PCCP to refinance Greybarn Amityville, a 335-unit multifamily property in Amityville, NY. The property, developed in three phases between 2016 and 2020, includes both market-rate and workforce housing units, along with ground-floor retail. The refinancing was facilitated by JLL, with the lender noting the property's strong performance, robust amenity package, and the owner's management capabilities in a competitive lending environment. The Long Island rental market's low new supply and high incomes are expected to support the property's success.

data_points.notable_features: Features 269 market-rate apartments and 66 workforce units, along with ground-floor retail space. Amenities include a swimming pool, fitness center, and coworking spaces.
data_points.project_notes: Developed in three phases between 2016 and 2020.

articles.market_intelligence: As of Q1 2026, no multifamily projects of 50 or more units were under construction in southwest Suffolk County, a submarket that added an average of 417 units annually over the preceding decade.

articles.title: Faris Lee Brokers $37.3M Sale of 97,319 SF Retail Space in Lakewood, California
articles.narrative: Faris Lee Investments has brokered the sale of a 97,319-square-foot retail portion of Lakewood Center in Lakewood, California. A consortium of multiple owners sold the asset for $37.3 million to an undisclosed buyer. This transaction marks the second significant portion of Lakewood Center sold by Faris Lee this year, bringing their total sales for the center to $76 million.

data_points.notable_features: Located on 5 acres within a larger retail center that occupies a full city block at four major signalized intersections.

articles.title: Bascom Group Obtains $30.8M Refinancing for 200-Unit Multifamily Community in Las Vegas
articles.narrative: The Bascom Group has secured a $30.8 million refinancing loan for The Gateway Villas Apartments, a 200-unit multifamily community in Las Vegas. Bridge Investment Group provided the financing for the garden-style property, which Bascom Group originally acquired in an off-market transaction in December 2021. The community offers a range of amenities and unit features designed to appeal to residents.

data_points.notable_features: Garden-style property with private patios or balconies, fitness center, resident clubhouse, pool, barbecue area, and putting green.
data_points.project_notes: Property was built in 1984 and 1985. Bascom Group acquired the property in an off-market transaction in December 2021.

articles.title: Joint Venture Acquires 122-Unit Seniors Housing Community in San Diego
articles.narrative: A joint venture between a private equity group and a local operator has acquired Canyon Villas, a 122-unit seniors housing community in San Diego's Clairemont neighborhood. The San Diego Christian Foundation sold the property for an undisclosed price, which a board member noted was significantly higher than initial broker estimates. The community offers independent living, assisted living, and memory care options.

data_points.notable_features: Features independent living, assisted living, and memory care residences; amenities include a courtyard, library, gazebo, activity room, and transportation services.

articles.title: Coastal Commercial Arranges Sale of Historic Balboa Theater in Newport Beach, California
articles.narrative: Coastal Commercial has arranged the sale of the historic Balboa Theater in Newport Beach, California. A local family office sold the nearly century-old landmark to a local private real estate investor. The new owner plans to restore the theater, which has been closed for approximately 35 years despite previous restoration efforts.

data_points.address: 707 E. Balboa Blvd., Newport Beach, CA
data_points.notable_features: Historic landmark theater, originally opened as Ritz Theater.
data_points.project_notes: The theater closed in 1991 and has remained closed for approximately 35 years.

articles.title: Comstock Obtains $299.1M Refinancing for Office Towers at Reston Station in Northern Virginia
articles.narrative: Comstock Holding Cos. Inc. has secured a $299.1 million refinancing package for three office towers at its Reston Station mixed-use development in Northern Virginia. The financing, arranged by Eastdil Secured Savills, was provided by Bank of America and used to repay an existing loan from Blackstone Real Estate Debt Strategies. The office towers, which are part of a 90-acre transit-oriented development, were fully leased at the time of the refinancing.

data_points.notable_features: Part of a 90-acre mixed-use development surrounding the Wiehle-Reston East Metro Station.
data_points.project_notes: Refinancing used to fully repay a $292.9 million loan provided by Blackstone Real Estate Debt Strategies.

articles.title: PARADIGM closes 85,870-square-foot industrial sale in Jackson
articles.narrative: PARADIGM Real Estate Corporation brokered the sale of an 85,870-square-foot Class-A industrial facility in Jackson, Wisconsin. Jackson Industrial13 LLC acquired the property from J5 Enterprise LLC in an owner/user transaction that closed in early Q4 2026. The facility is situated on an 11.9-acre site.

articles.title: Opus-developed 289,080-square-foot industrial building in Merrillville nearly 80% leased
articles.narrative: Opus announced that its 289,080-square-foot speculative industrial building in Merrillville, Indiana, is now nearly 80% leased after securing two new tenants. Both companies are relocating to the Class-A facility, seeking modern, larger spaces to accommodate growth and remain close to their existing employee bases. The remaining 61,910 square feet is actively being marketed for lease, indicating strong demand for industrial space in the area.

articles.title: Kiser Group expands to Cincinnati market with addition of veteran broker
articles.narrative: Kiser Group, a Chicago-based multifamily investment sales brokerage, has expanded its operations into Ohio by appointing Stasiu "Stash" Geleszinski as Senior Director. Geleszinski will spearhead the firm's growth in Cincinnati, focusing on multifamily investment sales across Cincinnati, Dayton, and Columbus. His strategy involves targeting private capital multifamily transactions, particularly properties with 50 or more units, and serving professional investment groups and institutional owners. The firm aims to leverage Geleszinski's nearly two decades of experience and over $2 billion in transaction volume to establish a strong regional presence.

articles.title: Berkadia brokers sale of 139-unit student housing property in Lawrence
articles.narrative: Berkadia has brokered the sale of Orchard Corners & Suites, a 139-unit student housing property in Lawrence, Kansas. The garden-style community, which serves The University of Kansas, was sold by Utah-based Redstone Residential. The transaction was facilitated by Berkadia's student housing and Kansas City investment sales teams.

data_points.notable_features: Garden-style student housing property serving The University of Kansas.

articles.title: St. Louis’ Lawrence Group adds interior design professional
articles.narrative: Lauren Moore has joined Lawrence Group's retail team as an Interior Design Professional, bringing over a decade of experience to the St. Louis-based firm. Her background includes roles at Cushman & Wakefield and ArcVision, Inc., enhancing Lawrence Group's capabilities in interior design.

articles.title: Brightshore Acquires Newly Built Long Island City Luxury Apartments
articles.narrative: Brightshore Capital LP, operating through its Opportunity Zone Fund II, has acquired DŌMI, a newly constructed 190-unit luxury multifamily property in Long Island City, for over $143 million. The acquisition was supported by a $98.5 million loan from Affinius Capital. The property's appeal stems from Long Island City's strong residential growth, excellent transportation, and ongoing infrastructure investments, which Brightshore believes will drive long-term value given the limited new development opportunities in the area.

data_points.notable_features: Newly constructed luxury multifamily property with convenient access to Manhattan and robust transportation links.

articles.title: Harrison Street Asset Management, Harbert Management Corporation Form Seniors Housing Partnership
articles.narrative: Harrison Street Asset Management and Harbert Management Corporation have formed a joint venture to develop two senior housing communities, The Palmer in Pasadena, California, and The Belle Mare in Potomac, Maryland. These projects will add 80 and 94 units respectively, contributing to Harbert South Bay's active construction portfolio of over 800 units. PNC Bank is providing construction financing for both communities, which are designed to meet demand in attractive, supply-constrained markets.

articles.title: Refinancing Multifamily Borrowers Face 41% Increase in Interest Rates
articles.narrative: Multifamily borrowers are encountering a substantial 41% increase in interest rates when refinancing maturing loans, according to a Newmark report. The average interest rate for new multifamily loans has risen to 5.69%, up from 4.04% for loans maturing in Q3 2026. This creates a negative leverage scenario, as current cap rates average 5.5%. While widespread distress has not yet materialized, property sales prices are showing pressure, with 39% of multifamily properties selling below their inflation-adjusted prior purchase price, a significant jump from 6% in late 2021.
articles.market_intelligence: Multifamily borrowers face limited protection against further increases in benchmark rates due to already narrow loan spreads. The share of properties trading below their previous inflation-adjusted purchase price is expected to remain elevated as borrowers refinance.

articles.title: Seattle Social Housing Developer to Buy West Seattle Apartments for $68M
articles.narrative: The Seattle Social Housing Developer (SSHD) is set to acquire Youngstown Flats, a nearly 200-unit apartment building in West Seattle, for approximately $68 million. This marks SSHD's second acquisition, expanding its portfolio to almost 350 units and surpassing its 2026 housing pipeline goal. The acquisition is significant as it aims to re-establish permanent affordability for about 30 residents, whose previous Multifamily Tax Exemption program had lapsed under the prior owner, thereby protecting them from potential economic displacement.

data_points.notable_features: Six-story building located in the heart of West Seattle.
data_points.project_notes: The previous owner allowed an affordability program (MFTE) to lapse. SSHD's acquisition will offer a permanent affordability program to protect existing residents.

articles.title: Rexford Sells Fullerton Industrial Building For $50.2M: The Los Angeles Deal Sheet
articles.narrative: Rexford Industrial has sold a 136,000-square-foot industrial building in Fullerton, CA for $50.2 million to Terra Industrial. The buyer, a manufacturing company, will consolidate its operations into this single facility, having previously occupied two separate facilities totaling 180,000 square feet. This acquisition represents a strategic move for Terra Industrial to optimize its operational footprint.

articles.title: What's At Stake For CRE In Tuesday's U.S. Midterm
articles.narrative: The upcoming 2026 U.S. midterm elections hold significant implications for commercial real estate, with key issues such as data centers, housing policy, and property taxes directly on the ballot. The outcomes of these races and measures could reshape regulatory environments and economic incentives impacting various CRE sectors.

articles.title: The Data Center Election That Matters Isn't In Congress
articles.narrative: The 2026 midterm elections have brought data centers to the forefront of political discourse, yet the actual impact of these elections on the data center industry is likely to be more limited than the prevailing rhetoric implies.
